paragraphs.text: Baggage claim
paragraphs.translation: 行李提取

paragraphs.text: You can refer to the flight information television screens on Level Two for the allocation of your baggage claim belt. Free trolleys are available near all baggage claim belts and our friendly porters are at your service on request. Should you require their assistance with carrying luggage, please ask at the Information Desk. You can proceed to the Lost and Found Counter for advice if you cannot find your baggage or would like to report damaged baggage.
paragraphs.translation:
行李提取
您可以参考二层航班信息电视屏幕，了解您的行李提取传送带分配情况。
所有行李提取传送带附近均提供免费手推车，友好的搬运工可根据您的需求提供服务。
如果您需要他们协助搬运行李，请向问讯处咨询。
如果您找不到行李或想报告行李损坏，可以前往失物招领柜台寻求建议。

paragraphs.text: Customs clearance
paragraphs.translation: 海关清关

paragraphs.text: Please use the Green Channel for your baggage clearance if you do not have controlled or prohibited items to declare, or have not exceeded your Duty-Free Concession. Please use the Red Channel if you have items to declare or are in doubt.
paragraphs.translation:
如果您没有需申报的管制或禁止携带物品，或者未超过免税优惠限额，请使用绿色通道办理行李通关。
如果您有物品需要申报或不确定，请使用红色通道。

paragraphs.text: Hotel reservations
paragraphs.translation: 酒店预订

paragraphs.text: You can make these at the Hotel Reservation Counter with a S$10.00 per reservation deposit, deductible from your hotel bill at the end of your stay. These counters do not handle the transit hotels. For these, go to the Reception Desk on Level Three.
paragraphs.translation:
您可以在酒店预订柜台办理这些手续，每次预订需支付10新元押金，该押金将在您住宿结束时从酒店账单中扣除。
这些柜台不办理过境酒店业务。
如需办理过境酒店，请前往三楼的接待台。

paragraphs.text: Singapore Airport
paragraphs.translation: 新加坡机场

paragraphs.text: Goods and Services Tax (GST) relief
paragraphs.translation: 商品及服务税（GST）减免

paragraphs.text: A 3% Goods and Services Tax (GST) is levied on the sale of all goods imported into Singapore. If you are a visitor, returning citizen or permanent resident of Singapore, you may be granted GST relief under certain conditions.
paragraphs.translation:
对进口到新加坡的所有商品的销售征收3%的商品及服务税。
如果你是访客、回国公民或新加坡永久居民，在特定条件下可能获得商品及服务税减免。

paragraphs.text: Tax-free shopping
paragraphs.translation: 免税购物

paragraphs.text: As a tourist or visitor, you can apply for a refund at Customs of the 3% GST on goods purchased during your stay in Singapore, provided you:
paragraphs.translation: 作为游客或访客，您可以就逗留新加坡期间购买的商品向海关申请退还3%的商品及服务税，前提是您：

paragraphs.text: • shop at stores with the 'Tax Free Shopping' logo
paragraphs.translation:
免税购物
在带有'免税购物'标志的商店购物

paragraphs.text: • spend a minimum amount of S$100 at any one shop, and at least S$300 in total
paragraphs.translation: 在任何一家商店消费至少100新元，并且总计消费至少300新元。

paragraphs.text: • obtain a Global Refund Cheque from the place of purchase.
paragraphs.translation: • 从购买处获取一张全球退税支票。

paragraphs.text: When collecting your refund you have several choices - cash, bank cheque, or Changi Airport Shopping Voucher, which comes with an additional 10% in value.
paragraphs.translation: 在领取退税时，您有几种选择：现金、银行支票或樟宜机场购物券，该购物券额外赠送10%的价值。

paragraphs.text: Please note that a handling fee will be deducted from the GST amount for the refund service.
paragraphs.translation: 请注意，退税服务会从商品及服务税金额中扣除一笔手续费。

paragraphs.text: Singapore Guide
paragraphs.translation: 新加坡指南

paragraphs.text: A walk around the Orchard Road district
paragraphs.translation: 在乌节路区域散步

paragraphs.text: The route begins just opposite the Orchard MRT station at the Singapore Marriott Hotel. This eye-catching landmark has a distinctive Chinese-styled green roof and red pillars.
paragraphs.translation:
这条路线始于新加坡万豪酒店，正对着乌节地铁站。
这座引人注目的地标拥有独特的中国风格绿色屋顶和红色柱子。

paragraphs.text: In 1958 a former lace-pedlar, C.K. Tang, foresaw that the area could become a bustling shopping centre, since residents in the neighbouring Tanglin district had to pass en-route to work at the commercial centre, Raffles Place. So with roof tiles brought in from his hometown in the Swatow city of China, Tang built a department store on what was then a cheap, isolated plot of land. The plot faced a cemetery, which could be considered a bad omen. His foresight paid off. Today, Tangs is one of Singapore's most prominent and recognised home-grown department stores, proudly showcasing local fashion and household products. Even when the original building was torn down in 1982 to give way to the present superstore and skyscraper hotel, it retained its unique Chinese architecture.
paragraphs.translation:
1958年，曾是一名花边小贩的C. K. Tang预见到，由于附近东陵区的居民在前往商业中心莱佛士坊上班的途中必须经过此地，该区域可能会成为一个繁华的购物中心。
于是，Tang从中国汕头老家运来屋顶瓦片，在一块当时廉价且偏僻的土地上建造了一家百货商店。
这块土地对面是一片墓地，这可能会被视为不祥之兆。
他的远见得到了回报。
如今，Tangs是新加坡最著名且备受认可的本土百货商店之一，自豪地展示着当地时尚和家居产品。
即使原建筑在1982年被拆除，以让位给现在的超级商店和摩天酒店，它仍然保留了独特的中国建筑风格。

paragraphs.text: From the foyer at Tangs, turn left to Lucky Plaza. One of the oldest along Orchard Road, this mall is a perennial favourite with shoppers. Be amazed by the staggering array of cosmetics, jewellery, leather goods and hi-fi equipment. Prices, though, are not always fixed, so bring along a good set of bargaining skills.
paragraphs.translation:
从Tangs百货的门厅出发，向左转便是幸运广场。
作为乌节路上最古老的商场之一，这家购物中心常年深受顾客喜爱。
琳琅满目的化妆品、珠宝、皮具和高保真音响设备令人惊叹不已。
然而，价格并非一成不变，因此请带上你娴熟的讨价还价技巧。

paragraphs.text: Coming out of Lucky Plaza, continue along Orchard Road and enter the Paragon Shopping Centre. Apart from a wide range of shops and restaurants, there is also a Singapore Airlines Service Centre to facilitate bookings and offer information to tourists. Also available are a number of computer terminals for self-booking. Check out the life-sized sculptures by a well-known sculptor, Sun Yu-li, outside the shopping centre. These were inspired by depictions of life in rock paintings dating back 20,000 years ago in Inner Mongolia.
paragraphs.translation:
走出幸运广场，沿着乌节路继续前行，进入百丽宫购物中心。
除了各种商店和餐厅，这里还有一个新加坡航空服务中心，方便游客进行预订并提供信息。
此外还设有多个电脑终端，供游客自行预订。
不妨去看看购物中心外著名雕塑家孙玉丽创作的真人大小雕塑。
这些雕塑的灵感源自中国内蒙古地区可追溯到两万年前的岩画中对生活的描绘。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Writing a personal CV that will attract employers

paragraphs.text: A

You are unique. No one has the same behavioural make-up that you have. Likewise, everyone's career history is also unique. Why is it then that a great many CVs are mostly descriptions of past jobs or standard CV templates and give away very little about the individual behind the CV? It's almost as if the majority of job seekers are afraid to let their own personality shine through.
paragraphs.translation:
你是独一无二的。
没有人拥有与你相同的行为构成。
同样地，每个人的职业履历也是独特的。
那么，为什么很多简历主要是对过往工作的描述或标准模板，却很少透露简历背后个人的特点呢？
这几乎就像大多数求职者害怕让自己的个性展现出来一样。

paragraphs.text: B

Perhaps in a corporate world where everyone feels they have to have the same professional image - dress in dark, formal suits, for example - the same is subconsciously felt to be true for CV writing. But there's a difficulty here: you want your CV to stand out and yet at the same time are afraid of saying anything that might make you stand out? The problem with the above thinking is painfully clear. Your CV will be dull, and likely to be swiftly passed over by an employer. Surely it is much better to be brave? To define your personal brand, as marketers might say. This isn't about making unsupportable statements: it's about choosing words that describe the qualities that drive your success. In short, what makes you good at your job.
paragraphs.translation:
也许在这样一个企业界里，每个人都觉得自己必须拥有相同的职业形象——例如，穿着深色的正装——人们潜意识里也认为简历写作也应如此。
但这里有一个难题：你希望你的简历脱颖而出，同时又害怕说出任何可能让你显得与众不同的话？
上述思维的弊端显而易见，令人痛心。
你的简历会变得枯燥乏味，很可能被雇主迅速略过。
当然，勇敢一点不是更好吗？
正如营销人员可能会说的，定义你的个人品牌。
这不是要做出毫无根据的声明，而是选择描述那些驱动你成功的品质的词语。
简而言之，就是什么让你擅长自己的工作。

paragraphs.text: C

Writing about oneself can sometimes be difficult. It involves the ability to see yourself from different people's viewpoints. Working with a professional CV writer is one way to achieve that and to present your character positively within a CV. Asking a colleague that you trust is also a good way to find out how others see your strengths.
paragraphs.translation:
描述自己有时可能会很困难。
它涉及从不同人的视角审视自己的能力。
与专业的简历撰写者合作是实现这一目标并在简历中积极展现个人特质的一种方式。
向你信任的同事请教，也是了解他人如何看待你优势的好方法。

paragraphs.text: D

Try not to use classic recruitment cliches. Everyone says they have great 'communication' or 'organisational' skills. This gets ignored by recruiters. So, instead think carefully about who you are and what you bring and then try to describe yourself. In that way you give recruiters something original to engage with, something that grabs their attention.
paragraphs.translation:
尽量避免使用经典的招聘陈词滥调。
每个人都说自己拥有出色的“沟通”或“组织”技能。
这一点常常被招聘人员忽视。
因此，相反地，要仔细思考你是谁以及你能带来什么，然后试着描述自己。
这样一来，你就能给招聘人员提供一些原创的、能够吸引他们注意力的内容。
尽量避免使用常见的招聘陈词滥调。
每个人都说自己拥有出色的‘沟通’或‘组织’技能。
这会被招聘人员忽略。
因此，相反，要仔细思考你是谁以及你能带来什么，然后试着描述自己。
这样，你就能给招聘人员提供一些原创的内容来吸引他们的注意力。

paragraphs.text: The value of being organised at work
paragraphs.translation: 在工作中保持条理的价值

paragraphs.text: Being organised is one of the most effective skills a business person can acquire because when we're organised, we think more clearly. We're in tune with our targets and know how to reach them. Here are my top tips to bring order to your business life:
paragraphs.translation:
有条理是商务人士能够掌握的最有效的技能之一，因为当我们有条理时，我们的思维更加清晰。
我们与目标保持一致，并知道如何实现它们。
以下是我为您的商务生活带来秩序的首要建议：

paragraphs.text: Organise your workspace
paragraphs.translation: 整理你的工作空间

paragraphs.text: Don’t underestimate time lost or stress caused from an inefficient working environment. To restore order:
paragraphs.translation:
不要低估低效工作环境所导致的时间浪费或压力。
为了恢复秩序：

paragraphs.text: • Cut down documents and stationery to the bare essentials. Be ruthless and remove anything that doesn't directly serve a function in your day-to-day activity. One or two carefully selected photos to make your desk feel like home are fine, but avoid too many.
paragraphs.translation:
• 将文档和文具精简至最基本的需求。
要坚决果断，移除任何在你日常活动中没有直接功能的物品。
精心挑选一两张照片来让办公桌有家的感觉是可以的，但要避免过多。

paragraphs.text: • Create locations where you will keep all your work materials to make retrieval easy. Do this logically based on where you tend to use the items; for example, store spare copy paper near the printer. Move outside your immediate reach anything you use infrequently. Always return items once you have used them so they'll be where you expect them next time.
paragraphs.translation:
创建存放所有工作资料的位置，以便于轻松取用。
根据你通常使用物品的位置合理地进行分类；例如，将备用复印纸存放在打印机附近。
将不常用的物品移出你伸手可及的范围。
使用完物品后务必归还原位，以便下次使用时它们仍在预期位置。

paragraphs.text: • Frustration ensues when you're searching for a client proposal, but it's buried among random papers. Eliminate desktop chaos by using trays, magazine files, or whatever you fancy and add clear labels such as 'In', 'Out', For Action', 'Current Projects’ or other relevant categories.
paragraphs.translation:
当你在寻找客户提案时，它却埋没在杂乱的纸张中，这会导致挫败感。
使用托盘、杂志文件架或任何你喜欢的收纳工具，并添加清晰的标签，如“待办”、“已处理”、“待行动”、“当前项目”或其他相关类别，来消除桌面的混乱。

paragraphs.text: • Be brutally honest about what you must keep. Studies suggest that 80% of what we file is never accessed again. Ask: do I know of a tax or legal requirement for retaining it? Why would this be important to me in future? Avoid 'miscellaneous' as a category- you won't remember what's in there.
paragraphs.translation:
• 对自己必须保留的东西要极其坦诚。
研究表明，我们存档的文件中有80%从未再次查阅。
问问自己：我是否知道保留它有税务或法律上的要求？
它未来为何对我重要？
避免使用“杂项”作为类别——你不会记得里面有什么。

paragraphs.text: Effective planning
paragraphs.translation: 有效的规划

paragraphs.text: Plan your work; work your plan. Time spent planning saves untold hours in execution. Implementing regular planning strategies will sharpen your focus, thereby keeping you on track with your work.
paragraphs.translation:
规划你的工作；执行你的计划。
花在规划上的时间能节省大量执行时间。
实施定期规划策略将提升你的专注力，从而使你的工作保持在正轨上。

paragraphs.text: Start planning today for tomorrow. Near the close of each work day, implement a
paragraphs.translation:
从今天开始为明天做规划。
在每个工作日临近结束时，执行一项

paragraphs.text: 10- to 15-minute routine to wrap up loose ends and prioritise key tasks. A good plan for tomorrow allows you to clear your head and enjoy your evening.
paragraphs.translation: 一个好的明日计划能让你清空思绪，享受晚间时光。

paragraphs.text: Once a week, ring-fence a 60- to 90-minute appointment with yourself for larger scale planning. Use the time to do research or any of the thinking that normally takes a back seat.
paragraphs.translation:
每周一次，为自己预留60至90分钟的时间进行更大规模的规划。
利用这段时间进行研究或进行那些通常被搁置的思考。

parts.source_article_title: Writing a personal CV that will attract employers

sentence_translations.sentence: You are unique.
sentence_translations.translation: 你是独一无二的。

sentence_translations.sentence: No one has the same behavioural make-up that you have.
sentence_translations.translation: 没有人拥有与你相同的行为构成。

sentence_translations.sentence: Likewise, everyone's career history is also unique.
sentence_translations.translation: 同样地，每个人的职业履历也是独特的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Why is it then that a great many CVs are mostly descriptions of past jobs or standard CV templates and give away very little about the individual behind the CV?
sentence_translations.translation: 那么，为什么很多简历主要是对过往工作的描述或标准模板，却很少透露简历背后个人的特点呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: It's almost as if the majority of job seekers are afraid to let their own personality shine through.
sentence_translations.translation: 这几乎就像大多数求职者害怕让自己的个性展现出来一样。

sentence_translations.sentence: Perhaps in a corporate world where everyone feels they have to have the same professional image - dress in dark, formal suits, for example - the same is subconsciously felt to be true for CV writing.
sentence_translations.translation: 也许在这样一个企业界里，每个人都觉得自己必须拥有相同的职业形象——例如，穿着深色的正装——人们潜意识里也认为简历写作也应如此。

sentence_translations.sentence: But there's a difficulty here: you want your CV to stand out and yet at the same time are afraid of saying anything that might make you stand out?
sentence_translations.translation: 但这里有一个难题：你希望你的简历脱颖而出，同时又害怕说出任何可能让你显得与众不同的话？

sentence_translations.sentence: The problem with the above thinking is painfully clear.
sentence_translations.translation: 上述思维的弊端显而易见，令人痛心。

sentence_translations.sentence: Your CV will be dull, and likely to be swiftly passed over by an employer.
sentence_translations.translation: 你的简历会变得枯燥乏味，很可能被雇主迅速略过。

sentence_translations.sentence: Surely it is much better to be brave?
sentence_translations.translation: 当然，勇敢一点不是更好吗？

sentence_translations.sentence: To define your personal brand, as marketers might say.
sentence_translations.translation: 正如营销人员可能会说的，定义你的个人品牌。

sentence_translations.sentence: This isn't about making unsupportable statements: it's about choosing words that describe the qualities that drive your success.
sentence_translations.translation: 这不是要做出毫无根据的声明，而是选择描述那些驱动你成功的品质的词语。

sentence_translations.sentence: In short, what makes you good at your job.
sentence_translations.translation: 简而言之，就是什么让你擅长自己的工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: Writing about oneself can sometimes be difficult.
sentence_translations.translation: 描述自己有时可能会很困难。

sentence_translations.sentence: It involves the ability to see yourself from different people's viewpoints.
sentence_translations.translation: 它涉及从不同人的视角审视自己的能力。

sentence_translations.sentence: Working with a professional CV writer is one way to achieve that and to present your character positively within a CV.
sentence_translations.translation: 与专业的简历撰写者合作是实现这一目标并在简历中积极展现个人特质的一种方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: Asking a colleague that you trust is also a good way to find out how others see your strengths.
sentence_translations.translation: 向你信任的同事请教，也是了解他人如何看待你优势的好方法。

sentence_translations.sentence: Try not to use classic recruitment cliches.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽量避免使用经典的招聘陈词滥调。

sentence_translations.sentence: Everyone says they have great 'communication' or 'organisational' skills.
sentence_translations.translation: 每个人都说自己拥有出色的“沟通”或“组织”技能。

sentence_translations.sentence: This gets ignored by recruiters.
sentence_translations.translation: 这一点常常被招聘人员忽视。

sentence_translations.sentence: So, instead think carefully about who you are and what you bring and then try to describe yourself.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，相反地，要仔细思考你是谁以及你能带来什么，然后试着描述自己。

sentence_translations.sentence: In that way you give recruiters something original to engage with, something that grabs their attention.
sentence_translations.translation: 这样一来，你就能给招聘人员提供一些原创的、能够吸引他们注意力的内容。

sentence_translations.sentence: In that way you give recruiters something original to engage with, something that grabs their attention.

sentence_translations.sentence: The value of being organised at work
sentence_translations.translation: 在工作中保持条理的价值

sentence_translations.sentence: Being organised is one of the most effective skills a business person can acquire because when we're organised, we think more clearly.
sentence_translations.translation: 有条理是商务人士能够掌握的最有效的技能之一，因为当我们有条理时，我们的思维更加清晰。

sentence_translations.sentence: We're in tune with our targets and know how to reach them.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们与目标保持一致，并知道如何实现它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here are my top tips to bring order to your business life:
sentence_translations.translation: 以下是我为您的商务生活带来秩序的首要建议：

sentence_translations.sentence: Organise your workspace
sentence_translations.translation: 整理你的工作空间

sentence_translations.sentence: Don’t underestimate time lost or stress caused from an inefficient working environment.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要低估低效工作环境所导致的时间浪费或压力。

sentence_translations.sentence: To restore order:
sentence_translations.translation: 为了恢复秩序：

sentence_translations.sentence: • Cut down documents and stationery to the bare essentials.
sentence_translations.translation: • 将文档和文具精简至最基本的需求。

sentence_translations.sentence: Be ruthless and remove anything that doesn't directly serve a function in your day-to-day activity.
sentence_translations.translation: 要坚决果断，移除任何在你日常活动中没有直接功能的物品。

sentence_translations.sentence: One or two carefully selected photos to make your desk feel like home are fine, but avoid too many.
sentence_translations.translation: 精心挑选一两张照片来让办公桌有家的感觉是可以的，但要避免过多。

sentence_translations.sentence: Create locations where you will keep all your work materials to make retrieval easy.
sentence_translations.translation: 创建存放所有工作资料的位置，以便于轻松取用。

sentence_translations.sentence: Do this logically based on where you tend to use the items; for example, store spare copy paper near the printer.
sentence_translations.translation: 根据你通常使用物品的位置合理地进行分类；例如，将备用复印纸存放在打印机附近。

sentence_translations.sentence: Move outside your immediate reach anything you use infrequently.
sentence_translations.translation: 将不常用的物品移出你伸手可及的范围。

sentence_translations.sentence: Always return items once you have used them so they'll be where you expect them next time.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用完物品后务必归还原位，以便下次使用时它们仍在预期位置。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Frustration ensues when you're searching for a client proposal, but it's buried among random papers.
sentence_translations.translation: 当你在寻找客户提案时，它却埋没在杂乱的纸张中，这会导致挫败感。

sentence_translations.sentence: Eliminate desktop chaos by using trays, magazine files, or whatever you fancy and add clear labels such as 'In', 'Out', For Action', 'Current Projects’ or other relevant categories.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用托盘、杂志文件架或任何你喜欢的收纳工具，并添加清晰的标签，如“待办”、“已处理”、“待行动”、“当前项目”或其他相关类别，来消除桌面的混乱。

sentence_translations.sentence: • Be brutally honest about what you must keep.
sentence_translations.translation: • 对自己必须保留的东西要极其坦诚。

sentence_translations.sentence: Studies suggest that 80% of what we file is never accessed again.
sentence_translations.translation: 研究表明，我们存档的文件中有80%从未再次查阅。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ask: do I know of a tax or legal requirement for retaining it?
sentence_translations.translation: 问问自己：我是否知道保留它有税务或法律上的要求？

sentence_translations.sentence: Why would this be important to me in future?
sentence_translations.translation: 它未来为何对我重要？

sentence_translations.sentence: Avoid 'miscellaneous' as a category- you won't remember what's in there.
sentence_translations.translation: 避免使用“杂项”作为类别——你不会记得里面有什么。

sentence_translations.sentence: Effective planning
sentence_translations.translation: 有效的规划

sentence_translations.sentence: Plan your work; work your plan.
sentence_translations.translation: 规划你的工作；执行你的计划。

sentence_translations.sentence: Time spent planning saves untold hours in execution.
sentence_translations.translation: 花在规划上的时间能节省大量执行时间。

sentence_translations.sentence: Implementing regular planning strategies will sharpen your focus, thereby keeping you on track with your work.
sentence_translations.translation: 实施定期规划策略将提升你的专注力，从而使你的工作保持在正轨上。

sentence_translations.sentence: Start planning today for tomorrow.
sentence_translations.translation: 从今天开始为明天做规划。

sentence_translations.sentence: Near the close of each work day, implement a
sentence_translations.translation: 在每个工作日临近结束时，执行一项

sentence_translations.sentence: Implement a 10- to 15-minute routine to wrap up loose ends and prioritise key tasks.
sentence_translations.translation: 执行一个10到15分钟的常规流程，以处理未完成的事项并优先安排关键任务。

sentence_translations.sentence: A good plan for tomorrow allows you to clear your head and enjoy your evening.
sentence_translations.translation: 一个好的明日计划能让你清空思绪，享受晚间时光。

sentence_translations.sentence: Once a week, ring-fence a 60- to 90-minute appointment with yourself for larger scale planning.
sentence_translations.translation: 每周一次，为自己预留60至90分钟的时间进行更大规模的规划。

sentence_translations.sentence: Use the time to do research or any of the thinking that normally takes a back seat.

Coal has been used as a source of fuel for over 5,000 years, but for most of that time it was probably gathered from places where it was exposed on the surface of the ground. It is possible that the Romans undertook some mining, but coal mines across Europe largely date from the 13th century. Thereafter coal production increased steadily and it gradually replaced charcoal and wood as a source of heat and energy.

此后，煤炭产量稳步增长，并逐渐取代木炭和木材，成为热能与能源的来源。

paragraphs.text: Initially, coal mines were fairly shallow, but they quickly reached the point where artificial lighting was necessary. At first the lights used would have been no different from those used domestically candles and simple oil lamps. But as coal mines became deeper, miners encountered a new and terrible problem - firedamp. This was a natural gas, principally consisting of methane, that exploded on contact with a naked flame. The first known major firedamp explosion, which killed 99 people, took place in Belgium in 1514 and as new technology was used to mine at increasingly deep levels, the problem got worse.
paragraphs.translation:
最初，煤矿相当浅，但很快便达到了需要人工照明的程度。
起初，所使用的灯光与家用的蜡烛和简易油灯并无不同。
但随着煤矿深度的增加，矿工们遇到了一个可怕的新问题——沼氣（瓦斯）。

paragraphs.text: B

The simplest solution was to improve the ventilation of the mine. Many mines had only one shaft leading from the surface down to the working area below. paragraphs.text: But what was really needed was a safe lamp that could not ignite firedamp. The earliest forms of safety lighting sought to produce light without using a naked flame. One early method tried to utilise the fact that skins removed from decaying fish contain the element phosphorus, which emits light in the form of phosphorescence. Unfortunately, this phosphorus is highly toxic, flammable and can self-ignite-hardly desirable properties in a safety light.
paragraphs.translation:
但真正需要的是一种不会点燃瓦斯的安全灯。
最早的安全照明形式力求在不使用明火的情况下产生光线。

不幸的是，这种磷具有剧毒、易燃且能自燃——在安全灯中这绝非理想特性。

paragraphs.text: An alternative was a device invented in about 1750, consisting of a flint which struck against a piece of iron when a handle was turned, creating a shower of sparks which lit up the surrounding area. These were believed to be too cool to ignite firedamp. This device had major drawbacks - extra manpower had to be used to operate it continuously, and it also required regular maintenance and replacement. But worst of all, it was not in fact safe, and numerous accidents were caused when the sparks ignited firedamp. Nonetheless, it was considered to be the least dangerous form of lighting at the time.
paragraphs.translation:
另一种方案是约1750年发明的一种装置，由一个打火石组成，当转动把手时，打火石撞击一块铁，产生一串火花照亮周围区域。
人们认为这些火花温度太低，不会点燃瓦斯。
该装置有重大缺陷——需要额外人力持续操作，还需要定期维护和更换。
但最糟糕的是，它实际上并不安全，火花点燃瓦斯导致了无数事故。
尽管如此，它仍被认为是当时最不危险的照明形式。

人们认为这些火花温度太低，不足以点燃沼气。

parts.source_article_title: A significant development in mining safety

sentence_translations.sentence: Coal has been used as a source of fuel for over 5,000 years, but for most of that time it was probably gathered from places where it was exposed on the surface of the ground.
sentence_translations.translation: 煤炭作为燃料来源已被使用了5000多年，但在大部分时间里，它可能都是从地表裸露的地方采集的。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is possible that the Romans undertook some mining, but coal mines across Europe largely date from the 13th century.
sentence_translations.translation: 罗马人可能进行过一些开采，但欧洲各地的煤矿大多始于13世纪。

sentence_translations.sentence: Thereafter coal production increased steadily and it gradually replaced charcoal and wood as a source of heat and energy.
sentence_translations.translation: 此后，煤炭产量稳步增长，并逐渐取代木炭和木材，成为热能和能源的来源。

sentence_translations.sentence: Initially, coal mines were fairly shallow, but they quickly reached the point where artificial lighting was necessary.
sentence_translations.translation: 最初，煤矿相当浅，但很快便达到了需要人工照明的程度。

sentence_translations.sentence: At first the lights used would have been no different from those used domestically candles and simple oil lamps.
sentence_translations.translation: 起初，所使用的灯光与家用的蜡烛和简易油灯并无不同。

sentence_translations.sentence: But as coal mines became deeper, miners encountered a new and terrible problem - firedamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 但随着煤矿深度的增加，矿工们遇到了一个可怕的新问题——沼氣（瓦斯）。

sentence_translations.sentence: This was a natural gas, principally consisting of methane, that exploded on contact with a naked flame.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是一种天然气，主要由甲烷组成，接触明火就会爆炸。

sentence_translations.sentence: The first known major firedamp explosion, which killed 99 people, took place in Belgium in 1514 and as new technology was used to mine at increasingly deep levels, the problem got worse.
sentence_translations.translation: 已知的第一次重大瓦斯爆炸发生在1514年的比利时，造成99人死亡，而随着新技术被用于越来越深的开采，问题变得更加严重。

sentence_translations.sentence: The simplest solution was to improve the ventilation of the mine.
sentence_translations.translation: 最简单的解决方法是改善矿井的通风条件。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many mines had only one shaft leading from the surface down to the working area below.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多矿井只有一条从地面通向下方工作区的竖井。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ventilation could be improved to some extent by dividing this into a downcast (bringing in fresh air) and an upcast (returning foul air and firedamp to the surface).
sentence_translations.translation: 通过将这条竖井分为下行通风（引入新鲜空气）和上行通风（将污浊空气和瓦斯送回地面），可以在一定程度上改善通风。

sentence_translations.sentence: But what was really needed was a safe lamp that could not ignite firedamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 但真正需要的是一种不会点燃瓦斯的安全灯。

sentence_translations.sentence: The earliest forms of safety lighting sought to produce light without using a naked flame.
sentence_translations.translation: 最早的安全照明形式力求在不使用明火的情况下产生光线。

sentence_translations.sentence: One early method tried to utilise the fact that skins removed from decaying fish contain the element phosphorus, which emits light in the form of phosphorescence.
sentence_translations.translation: 一种早期方法试图利用腐烂鱼皮中含有磷元素这一事实，磷会以磷光形式发光。

sentence_translations.sentence: Unfortunately, this phosphorus is highly toxic, flammable and can self-ignite-hardly desirable properties in a safety light.
sentence_translations.translation: 不幸的是，这种磷具有剧毒、易燃且能自燃——在安全灯中这绝非理想特性。

sentence_translations.sentence: An alternative was a device invented in about 1750, consisting of a flint which struck against a piece of iron when a handle was turned, creating a shower of sparks which lit up the surrounding area.
sentence_translations.translation: 另一种方案是约1750年发明的一种装置，由一个打火石组成，当转动把手时，打火石撞击一块铁，产生一串火花照亮周围区域。

sentence_translations.sentence: These were believed to be too cool to ignite firedamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 人们认为这些火花温度太低，不会点燃瓦斯。

sentence_translations.sentence: This device had major drawbacks - extra manpower had to be used to operate it continuously, and it also required regular maintenance and replacement.
sentence_translations.translation: 该装置有重大缺陷——需要额外人力持续操作，还需要定期维护和更换。

sentence_translations.sentence: But worst of all, it was not in fact safe, and numerous accidents were caused when the sparks ignited firedamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 但最糟糕的是，它实际上并不安全，火花点燃瓦斯导致了无数事故。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nonetheless, it was considered to be the least dangerous form of lighting at the time.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管如此，它仍被认为是当时最不危险的照明形式。

sentence_translations.sentence: By about 1810 the problem was becoming acute, and in some cases there was no alternative to working in the dark.
sentence_translations.translation: 到约1810年，问题变得日益严峻，在某些情况下，除了在黑暗中工作别无选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some mines were being forced to stop production, with serious economic consequences for the mine owners and local communities.
sentence_translations.translation: 一些煤矿被迫停产，给矿主和当地社区带来了严重的经济后果。

sentence_translations.sentence: The general response, however, was to keep going and reluctantly accept the inevitable deaths from ignition of firedamp as a regrettable, but not especially remarkable, consequence of coal mining.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，普遍的应对方式是继续开采，并无奈地将瓦斯点燃导致的必然死亡视为煤矿开采中令人遗憾但并非特别值得注意的后果。

sentence_translations.sentence: The miners themselves could do little - they were largely illiterate, and depended on the mine owners for a livelihood.
sentence_translations.translation: 矿工们自己无能为力——他们大多目不识丁，依靠矿主维持生计。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the clerical, medical and legal professions were beginning to take notice.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，神职、医学和法律界开始注意到这一问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: After 92 men and boys were killed in 1812 by an explosion at Felling Colliery in northern England, several professional people took action and a society was set up to raise funds for the discovery of new methods of lighting and ventilating mines.
sentence_translations.translation: 1812年，英格兰北部的费林煤矿发生爆炸，造成92名男子和男孩死亡后，几位专业人士采取行动，成立了一个协会，为发现新的矿井照明和通风方法筹集资金。

sentence_translations.sentence: The first report of the society stated, 'It is to scientific men only that we must look up for assistance in providing a cheap and effectual remedy.'
sentence_translations.translation: 该协会的第一份报告指出：“我们只能依靠科学人士来提供廉价有效的补救措施。”

sentence_translations.sentence: As the leading chemist of the day, and an expert on gases, Sir Humphrey Davy was a natural choice from whom to seek help, and he was approached by the society in 1815.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为当时顶尖的化学家和气体专家，汉弗莱·戴维爵士自然是寻求帮助的对象，协会于1815年与他接洽。

sentence_translations.sentence: The general belief nowadays is that he was the inventor of the first miners' safety lamp, in which the flame was enclosed by a mesh screen containing very small holes.
sentence_translations.translation: 如今普遍认为他是第一盏矿工安全灯的发明者，该灯的火焰被一种带有极小孔的金属网罩包裹。

sentence_translations.sentence: Air could enter the lamp through the holes, but they were too small to allow the flame of the lamp to pass through them and ignite any firedamp present in the mine tunnels.
sentence_translations.translation: 空气可通过这些小孔进入灯内，但孔太小，无法让灯的火焰穿过并点燃矿井巷道中存在的任何瓦斯。

sentence_translations.sentence: Davy presented a paper describing the lamp in November 1815, and it was trialled in January 1816.
sentence_translations.translation: 戴维于1815年11月提交了一篇描述该灯的论文，并于1816年1月进行了试验。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, a few weeks prior to Davy's presentation, an engineer called George Stephenson had independently designed and demonstrated a lamp based on the same scientific principles.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，在戴维提交论文前几周，一位名叫乔治·斯蒂芬森的工程师已独立设计并演示了一盏基于相同科学原理的灯。

sentence_translations.sentence: After much discussion and argument, he was eventually recognised as deserving equal credit for the discovery, but the time needed for this recognition to be given meant that the miners' safety lamp had already been called the 'Davy lamp', and it is still called that today.
sentence_translations.translation: 经过大量讨论和争论，他最终被认可与该发现享有同等功劳，但由于获得这一认可所需的时间，矿工安全灯已被命名为“戴维灯”，并沿用至今。

sentence_translations.sentence: But in fact, the real inventor of the safety lamp was a man called Dr William Reid Clanny, who in 1813 had been awarded a silver medal by the Royal Society of Arts, Manufacturers and Commerce for his own version of a safety lamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 但事实上，安全灯的真正发明者是一位名叫威廉·里德·克兰尼博士的人，他于1813年因其自己版本的安全灯获得了皇家艺术、制造和商业学会颁发的银奖。

sentence_translations.sentence: Clanny's first lamp did not fulfil the needs of the ordinary working miner as it was rather heavy and cumbersome.
sentence_translations.translation: 克兰尼的第一盏灯相当沉重笨拙，未能满足普通矿工的需求。

sentence_translations.sentence: But rather than seeking to glory in his achievement, he recognised its deficiencies and continued to work to improve it, as well as sharing his knowledge with others.
sentence_translations.translation: 但他并未追求成就带来的荣耀，而是认识到其缺陷，继续致力于改进，并与他人分享自己的知识。

sentence_translations.sentence: George Stephenson acknowledged a debt to Clanny's research, and Humphrey Davy visited him in 1815 shortly before completing the design for his own safety lamp but to this day Dr Clanny remains a forgotten hero.

sentence_translations.sentence: An alternative was a device invented in about 1750, consisting of a flint which struck against a piece of iron when a handle was turned, creating a shower of sparks which lit up the surrounding area.
sentence_translations.translation: 另一种选择是约1750年发明的一种装置，由一个燧石组成，当手柄转动时，燧石击打一块铁片，产生火花雨照亮周围区域。

sentence_translations.sentence: These were believed to be too cool to ignite firedamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 人们认为这些火花温度太低，不足以点燃沼气。

sentence_translations.sentence: This device had major drawbacks - extra manpower had to be used to operate it continuously, and it also required regular maintenance and replacement.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种装置有重大缺陷——需要额外人力持续操作，并且还需要定期维护和更换。

sentence_translations.sentence: But worst of all, it was not in fact safe, and numerous accidents were caused when the sparks ignited firedamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 但最糟糕的是，它实际上并不安全，火花点燃沼气导致了大量事故。

sentence_translations.sentence: Nonetheless, it was considered to be the least dangerous form of lighting at the time.
sentence_translations.translation: 尽管如此，它在当时仍被认为是最不危险的照明形式。

sentence_translations.sentence: By about 1810 the problem was becoming acute, and in some cases there was no alternative to working in the dark.
sentence_translations.translation: 到约1810年，问题变得严重，在某些情况下，除了在黑暗中工作别无选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: Some mines were being forced to stop production, with serious economic consequences for the mine owners and local communities.
sentence_translations.translation: 一些煤矿被迫停产，给矿主和当地社区带来了严重的经济后果。

sentence_translations.sentence: The general response, however, was to keep going and reluctantly accept the inevitable deaths from ignition of firedamp as a regrettable, but not especially remarkable, consequence of coal mining.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，普遍的反应是继续生产，并勉强接受因沼气点燃导致的不可避免的死亡，将其视为煤矿开采中令人遗憾但并不特别引人注目的后果。

sentence_translations.sentence: The miners themselves could do little - they were largely illiterate, and depended on the mine owners for a livelihood.
sentence_translations.translation: 矿工们自己几乎无能为力——他们大多不识字，且依赖矿主谋生。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, the clerical, medical and legal professions were beginning to take notice.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，神职、医学和法律界人士开始关注此事。

sentence_translations.sentence: After 92 men and boys were killed in 1812 by an explosion at Felling Colliery in northern England, several professional people took action and a society was set up to raise funds for the discovery of new methods of lighting and ventilating mines.
sentence_translations.translation: 1812年，英国北部的费林煤矿发生爆炸，造成92名男子和男孩死亡后，几位专业人士采取行动，成立了一个协会，为发现新的矿井照明和通风方法筹集资金。

sentence_translations.sentence: The first report of the society stated, 'It is to scientific men only that we must look up for assistance in providing a cheap and effectual remedy.'
sentence_translations.translation: 该协会的首份报告指出：“我们必须只向科学人士寻求帮助，以提供廉价而有效的解决方案。”

sentence_translations.sentence: As the leading chemist of the day, and an expert on gases, Sir Humphrey Davy was a natural choice from whom to seek help, and he was approached by the society in 1815.
sentence_translations.translation: 作为当时顶尖的化学家和气体专家，汉弗莱·戴维爵士是寻求帮助的自然人选，协会于1815年向他求助。

sentence_translations.sentence: The general belief nowadays is that he was the inventor of the first miners' safety lamp, in which the flame was enclosed by a mesh screen containing very small holes.
sentence_translations.translation: 如今普遍认为他是第一盏矿工安全灯的发明者，该灯的火焰被一个带有极小孔的金属网罩封闭。

sentence_translations.sentence: Air could enter the lamp through the holes, but they were too small to allow the flame of the lamp to pass through them and ignite any firedamp present in the mine tunnels.
sentence_translations.translation: 空气可通过小孔进入灯内，但这些孔太小，无法让灯的火焰通过并点燃矿井巷道中存在的任何沼气。

sentence_translations.sentence: Davy presented a paper describing the lamp in November 1815, and it was trialled in January 1816.
sentence_translations.translation: 戴维于1815年11月提交了一篇描述该灯的论文，并于1816年1月进行了试验。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, a few weeks prior to Davy's presentation, an engineer called George Stephenson had independently designed and demonstrated a lamp based on the same scientific principles.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，在戴维提交论文的几周前，一位名叫乔治·史蒂芬森的工程师独立设计并展示了一款基于相同科学原理的灯。

sentence_translations.sentence: After much discussion and argument, he was eventually recognised as deserving equal credit for the discovery, but the time needed for this recognition to be given meant that the miners' safety lamp had already been called the 'Davy lamp', and it is still called that today.
sentence_translations.translation: 经过大量讨论和争论，他最终被承认应获得同等的发现荣誉，但由于获得这一认可所需的时间，矿工安全灯已被称为‘戴维灯’，至今仍沿用此名。

sentence_translations.sentence: But in fact, the real inventor of the safety lamp was a man called Dr William Reid Clanny, who in 1813 had been awarded a silver medal by the Royal Society of Arts, Manufacturers and Commerce for his own version of a safety lamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 但事实上，安全灯的真正发明者是一位名叫威廉·里德·克兰尼博士的人，他于1813年因其自己版本的安全灯获得了皇家艺术、制造业和商业学会颁发的银质奖章。

sentence_translations.sentence: Clanny's first lamp did not fulfil the needs of the ordinary working miner as it was rather heavy and cumbersome.
sentence_translations.translation: 克兰尼的第一盏灯因相当沉重和笨拙而未满足普通矿工的需求。

sentence_translations.sentence: But rather than seeking to glory in his achievement, he recognised its deficiencies and continued to work to improve it, as well as sharing his knowledge with others.
sentence_translations.translation: 但他并未陶醉于自己的成就，而是认识到其缺陷，继续努力改进，并与他人分享知识。

sentence_translations.sentence: George Stephenson acknowledged a debt to Clanny's research, and Humphrey Davy visited him in 1815 shortly before completing the design for his own safety lamp but to this day Dr Clanny remains a forgotten hero.
sentence_translations.translation: 乔治·史蒂芬森承认得益于克兰尼的研究，汉弗莱·戴维在1815年完成自己安全灯设计前不久拜访了他，但至今克兰尼博士仍是一位被遗忘的英雄。

sentence_translations.sentence: Coal has been used as a source of fuel for over 5,000 years, but for most of that time it was probably gathered from places where it was exposed on the surface of the ground.
sentence_translations.translation: 煤炭作为燃料来源已被使用了超过5000年，但在大部分时间里，它很可能只是从地表裸露的地方被捡拾而来。

sentence_translations.translation: 罗马人可能进行过一些开采，但欧洲各地的煤矿大多起源于13世纪。

sentence_translations.sentence: Thereafter coal production increased steadily and it gradually replaced charcoal and wood as a source of heat and energy.

sentence_translations.sentence: Initially, coal mines were fairly shallow, but they quickly reached the point where artificial lighting was necessary.
sentence_translations.translation: 最初，煤矿相当浅，但很快就达到了需要人工照明的程度。

sentence_translations.sentence: At first the lights used would have been no different from those used domestically candles and simple oil lamps.
sentence_translations.translation: 起初，所使用的灯具与家用的蜡烛和简易油灯并无区别。

sentence_translations.sentence: But as coal mines became deeper, miners encountered a new and terrible problem - firedamp.
sentence_translations.translation: 但随着煤矿变得更深，矿工们遇到了一个新的可怕问题——沼气。

sentence_translations.sentence: This was a natural gas, principally consisting of methane, that exploded on contact with a naked flame.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是一种天然气，主要成分为甲烷，一接触到明火就会爆炸。

sentence_translations.sentence: The first known major firedamp explosion, which killed 99 people, took place in Belgium in 1514 and as new technology was used to mine at increasingly deep levels, the problem got worse.
sentence_translations.translation: 已知首次重大沼气爆炸发生于1514年的比利时，造成99人死亡；随着新技术用于开采越来越深的煤层，这个问题变得更加严重。

sentence_translations.sentence: The simplest solution was to improve the ventilation of the mine.
sentence_translations.translation: 最简单的解决方案是改善矿井的通风。

sentence_translations.sentence: Many mines had only one shaft leading from the surface down to the working area below.

sentence_translations.sentence: Ventilation could be improved to some extent by dividing this into a downcast (bringing in fresh air) and an upcast (returning foul air and firedamp to the surface).

sentence_translations.sentence: The earliest forms of safety lighting sought to produce light without using a naked flame.
